# HexPiece 3.9.5

Your list on the Itsumade, the islands, the coat breaking in moves, the armors, Yoru's blade, the creative tabs and the mace. **Not tested
in game yet:** the build and every test suite pass (new checks: islands never closer than 520 blocks of open sea, coast to coast; no move
blows a coat out; the tabs' names), and every pose of the Itsumade and the coat in the worst move frames were rendered and checked.

## The Itsumade
- **No more smoke.** The "glow" shells round it are gone; its fire is bright on its own.
- **Third person, both views** (behind and in front): the camera pulls back and up to its body. No more seeing just its feet.
- **Wings as a bird's.** On the ground they are **folded against the body** (the upper arm laid back along the flank, the forearm folded
  forward, the hand folded back so the long feathers lie along the back); they breathe with it, shrug now and then, give a shake, lift a
  little for balance as it walks. In the air a real **wingbeat**: the downstroke with the wing fully spread, swept from high to low; the
  recovery with the wing **folded at the elbow and wrist** as it comes back up, opening again at the top; gliding spread with a dihedral;
  diving half folded; flared to land.
- **Slow, heavy beats** (about one every two seconds; it was up to one and a third a second: "a mosquito").
- **The feet walk.** A bird's stride: each foot planted flat and drawn back under the body, then lifted with the toes clenching shut,
  swung forward high and spread just before it plants again; the body dips as each foot takes the weight. Standing, the toes lie flat.
- **A living neck**: an S that sways and breathes, turns after where you look, snaps between looks like a bird's, thrusts forward with
  each step, undulates with the beats.
- **The hair moves**: waves running out to its tips, in gusts, blown back when it walks or flies.
- **The black ribbon looks like flames again**: its tongues keep their shape, only licking and fluttering at the tips.
- **Landing on its feet, never into the ground**: in the air your feet are held as far under its chest as its legs reach.
- **The transformation is YOU transforming**: your body convulses and **swells** in jolts (taller and taller, the arms thrown wide);
  then that swollen body **is** the Itsumade, the same height, standing upright as you stood, your thrown-wide arms now its wings spread
  wide; it keeps swelling in jolts to its full size while its body bends over into the bird's, the neck stretching, the tail unrolling
  joint by joint, the black ribbon snapping alight, the fire catching last, the scream, the wings folding. Going back the other way: it
  shrinks, straightens upright, and is you again (swollen, doubled over), shrinking back to yourself.

## The islands (TerraBlender, Biomes O' Plenty)
- **Placed, never merged**: one island per 2.8 km cell (a quarter of the cells open sea), each 0.4 to 1.5 km across with a lobed, ragged
  coast, each held off its neighbours: never closer than about half a kilometre of open sea coast to coast, usually 1 to 4 km. About 4%
  of the world is land. The biomes on them are still TerraBlender's and Biomes O' Plenty's. **A new world is needed** (old chunks keep
  their old land).

## The coat breaking in moves
- The "bubble" was the coat itself: an arm swung deep into it by a move pushed the cloth out of its way all at once. Now an arm a little
  into the cloth pushes it aside, an arm swung deep through it pushes it less and less, never into a bubble (checked over every move clip
  of the mod).

## The other armors
- The see-through boxes round the shoulders, arms, legs and head were **your skin's outer layer** standing out round the clothes (the
  clothes are cloth, thinner than that layer). Under a shirt or a coat the skin's jacket and sleeves are hidden now, under trousers its
  trouser legs, under a cap or a hat its hat layer, as a vanilla armor hides them.

## Yoru's blade
- The dark streaks on one side: the blade's sky glint is drawn as a layer exactly on the steel, and on one face it lost the depth test
  in patches. It is now drawn a hair toward your eye, always over the steel.

## The creative tabs
- **HexPiece Weapons**, **HexPiece Armor**, **HexPiece Devil Fruits**.

## The mace
- **Only in your hand when you select it**: swordsman mode no longer pulls it out of your inventory.
- **No rope** round the body for it.
- **The Conqueror's lightning (with Ryou) now tears off whatever you hold** instead of the body: a drawn sword or the mace along its own
  length, anything else out of your fist.

## Still to come (next)
- The mace's own sounds, every devil fruit on Minecraft's sounds (explosions and Haki kept), the gun's spin and left arm, the Flamingo
  Coat and the Greatest Swordsman, clothes for female bodies.
